title: Milestone 2: project-provided methodology bundles
description:
## Purpose

Let a project supply its own methodology bundles from the repository, alongside or instead of the built-ins.

## Scope

- `methodologies` entries accept `{ path: <dir> }` relative to the repository root, next to built-in names.
- Bundle layout mirrors the agent skills format so a skill author already knows it: `<dir>/METHODOLOGY.md` with frontmatter, optional supporting Markdown files it references, optional `tools/`.
- A project bundle may override a built-in by declaring the same `name`, so teams can fork `bdd` without forking Kanbus.
- Validation: missing directory, missing or malformed `METHODOLOGY.md`, duplicate names, and template errors report the bundle path.

## Definition of done

Specifications for path entries, override of a built-in, mixed built-in and custom ordering, and each validation error, in both implementations.
